criterion: Import preserves original fictional text and immutable identity/version or visibly rejects unreadable input
edge_case: Unsupported PDF or missing anchor
evidence_required: Fixture input compared byte-for-byte with stored text; rejected card absent

criterion: Every published field opens its exact quotation with version and resolvable anchor
edge_case: Repeated identical spans
evidence_required: Field-to-span tests distinguish repeated spans and verify focused source panel

criterion: A new upload without explicit replacement never wins disputed appointment details
edge_case: Friday note uploaded last
evidence_required: Two-source fixture plus task-gate rejection and visible unresolved relationship

criterion: Explicit claimed replacement shows old and new wording and does not authenticate source identity
edge_case: Uploader claims clinician authorship
evidence_required: Relationship event and UI copy preserve unauthenticated status

criterion: Conflicting appointment evidence remains conflicted after acknowledgement completion and rehearsal
edge_case: User acknowledges both sources
evidence_required: State snapshots before and after all three actions show no conflict resolution

criterion: Clarification preparation may cite both sources but cannot select either disputed appointment
edge_case: Task suggestion contains Friday time as chosen plan
evidence_required: Rejected candidate and neutral exported question with both source references

criterion: Changed transport dependency invalidates old acknowledgement and rehearsal current validity
edge_case: Explicit Thursday to Friday replacement
evidence_required: Before/after dependency state plus immutable historical events

criterion: An unchanged contact-only task retains validity through verified mapping without relabeling its old acknowledgement
edge_case: Unchanged office contact but changed appointment
evidence_required: Dependency mapping evidence and original revision label remain inspectable

criterion: Uncertain correspondence blocks dependent actions and requests review or disclosed document-wide invalidation
edge_case: One old span maps to two new spans
evidence_required: Ambiguous fixture trace and visible conservative fallback if selected

criterion: Historical completed transport arrangement remains completed for original revision while current view is stale
edge_case: Replacement after completion
evidence_required: Append-only event comparison and separate current-state/history screenshots

criterion: Service rejects obsolete acknowledgement atomically and client requires new explicit review
edge_case: v2 accepted before v1 acknowledgement arrives
evidence_required: Real two-context service trace showing rejection and absence of stale accepted event

criterion: Repeated accepted event key yields one event and repeated rejected stale write cannot restore validity
edge_case: Network retry after response loss
evidence_required: Persistence query and replay trace for successful and stale requests

criterion: Unauthorized actors cannot assign acknowledge or complete another isolated case
edge_case: Cross-session object identifier
evidence_required: Service access-denial evidence with unchanged victim case event count

criterion: Stale ownership or completion write is rejected by service revision checks
edge_case: Old tab completes transport after replacement
evidence_required: Race trace retaining original history without accepting obsolete mutation

criterion: Rehearsal cites exact reviewed version and mismatch feedback returns only to source wording
edge_case: Answer matches v1 while reviewing v2
evidence_required: Prompt and attempt records plus no invented corrective guidance

criterion: Unclear rehearsal answer remains unclear and does not become passed review or clinical approval
edge_case: User selects unclear repeatedly
evidence_required: Attempt history and unchanged coordination/evidence state

criterion: Medication quotations have no administration task reminder dose calculation or treatment control
edge_case: Medication-like text offered to task gate
evidence_required: Quotation fidelity fixture and deterministic rejection of prohibited task types

criterion: Keyboard can open inspect and close sources and complete review with visible focus and restored focus
edge_case: Source panel opened from change comparison
evidence_required: Keyboard walkthrough record including focus order and source/version accessible names

criterion: At 320 CSS pixels old/new blocks stack without hiding quotations state or actions
edge_case: Long source line and long version identifier
evidence_required: Viewport screenshots and no page-wide horizontal scrolling check

criterion: Offline snapshot and unsent acknowledgement never appear synchronized or accepted
edge_case: Disconnect during acknowledgement
evidence_required: Network interruption trace; refresh before explicit retry; persistent offline label

criterion: Cached model output and role switching show visible replay and simulation labels on every relevant screen
edge_case: Navigate from source to rehearsal
evidence_required: Screen sequence showing labels; real synchronization claim requires two-context evidence

criterion: Export preserves versions owners acknowledgement status unresolved questions and stale snapshot labels
edge_case: Export conflict and superseded completion
evidence_required: Export inspection compared with authoritative source/status records

criterion: Source instructions and malicious markup remain inert data with no external action or unsafe rendering
edge_case: Source requests network call or includes active markup
evidence_required: Safe rendering and outbound-request observation; source text preserved

criterion: Reset removes persisted synthetic session records and bounded input visibly rejects oversized content
edge_case: Reset then revisit old scoped reference
evidence_required: Storage/readback tests and bounded-input rejection without body/token logs

criterion: Ownership reconfirmation creates new revision-bound event separate from acknowledgement and completion
edge_case: Lee assigned v1 then reviews v2
evidence_required: Event records and UI distinguish all three actions without rewriting v1

criterion: Evaluator path reports actual denominators failures abstentions and run configuration with unrun states explicit
edge_case: No completed evaluation or unavailable replay/live distinction
evidence_required: Evaluator output inspected against stored run artifacts without fabricated metrics
